dialogue.en: Hi, I forgot to clock in yesterday morning.
dialogue.speaker: Employee
dialogue.zh: 你好，我昨天早上忘记打上班卡了。

dialogue.en: What time did you start working?
dialogue.speaker: Supervisor

dialogue.en: I started at 8 AM, right when the shift began.
dialogue.speaker: Employee
dialogue.zh: 早上八点，交班的时候就开始了。

dialogue.en: Okay, I'll fix it in the system. Try to remember next time.
dialogue.speaker: Supervisor
dialogue.zh: 好的，我在系统里帮你改一下。下次记得打卡。

dialogue.en: Thank you. It won't happen again.
dialogue.speaker: Employee
